SELECT l.location_id, l.location_name, SUM(oi.product_price) AS food_revenue
FROM jaffle_shop.dev.order_items AS oi
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN jaffle_shop.dev.locations AS l ON o.location_id = l.location_id
WHERE oi.is_food_item = 1
GROUP BY l.location_id, l.location_name
ORDER BY food_revenue DESC
LIMIT 500
